description: Search Graunt's catalog of evaluated data from many sellers. Returns matching packets with their id, title, and public URL. Start here to find data, then read one with fetch.

ai_generation.description: Keep only packets whose seller declares this AI-generation extent: NONE (not AI-generated), PARTIAL or FULL. A seller declaration, not a Graunt finding. AI processing of real material (cleaning, labeling, transcribing, captioning, structuring) is not AI generation, and a packet that contains video declares NONE.

camera_view.description: Only video listings shot from this camera view.

kind.description: Only listings of this kind. video: video listings.

rights_license_family.description: Keep only packets whose seller names this license family. In order, the values stand for: Proprietary, CC0 (public domain), CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC BY-NC, CC BY-ND, CC BY-NC-SA, CC BY-NC-ND, MIT, Apache 2.0, BSD 2-clause, BSD 3-clause, GPL 3.0, LGPL 3.0, MPL 2.0, ODC-BY, ODbL, Public domain, U.S. Government work. The rights the seller declared on the listing, which Graunt records: a seller declaration, not a Graunt finding.

rights_training_allowed.description: true keeps only packets whose seller declares that AI models may be trained on them; false keeps only those whose seller declares they may not. The rights the seller declared on the listing, which Graunt records: a seller declaration, not a Graunt finding.

video_subject.description: Only video listings whose footage shows this subject.

name: search
title: Search the Graunt catalog
